title: Preserving Fairness and Safety in Quantized LLMs Through Critical Weight Protection

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's likelihood preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentences and continuations using the StereoSet and CrowS-Pair benchmarks.
Evaluating unintended bias in toxicity classification by calculating ROC-AUC metrics (Subgroup AUC, BPSN, BNSP) on identity-referencing sentences using the Jigsaw dataset.
Assessing how often the model defaults to stereotypical answers in a multiple-choice question-answering task using ambiguous and disambiguated contexts from the multilingual MBBQ benchmark.
